## What it is

The mounting ring. The four M3 holes and the Ø19 cable window are the deck pattern and did not move. The slots are plain, under the bars, and the centre hole is Ø44.8 mm.

## Design notes

- Each slot is 16.8 × 8.2 mm, the 16.6 × 8.0 mm bar end plus 0.2 mm. A 2 mm chamfer on the outer bed corner keeps the slot off the nearest M3 hole. There is no tooth.
- The centre hole stops 2.4 mm short of the cable window. That window, not the slots, is what limits the hole.
- A recessed digit sits just inboard of each slot.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable window has to stay open.
- Don't move the four M3 holes or the cable window. Those are the deck.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: unchanged. The new bars use the same slots.
